title: cardamine impatiens subsp. pectinata
intro: Cardamine impatiens subsp. pectinata, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Bittercress, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the release of mucus, making it a potential treatment for coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include isothiocyanates, which are known for their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
